channel.title: Construction: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the construction sector.

item.title: Ilsung Construction: Ilsung Construction signed a KRW 84.12bn construction contract with Samsung Electronics for the Onyang Welfare Building in Asan.
AinsFac CNS: AinsFac CNS signed a KRW 1.44bn contract with YHT to design and build secondary battery control controllers for the US.
Sambu Construction: Sambu Construction applied to the Seoul Bankruptcy Court on 2026-11-23 to close its rehabilitation proceedings, citing completed major plan obligations.
Yooshin Engineering: Yooshin signed a KRW 63.6bn contract for feasibility study and FEED design consulting on five Hanoi urban rail lines in Vietnam.
Dongbu: Dongbu Corporation signed a KRW 140.2bn contract with Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation for the Jangji Garage Multi-level Development construction.

KUMHO Engineering & Construction: Kumho Engineering & Construction signed a KRW 175.3bn contract with Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation for the Jangji depot multi-level development construction.
Ipark Hyundai Development Company: IPARK Hyundai Development signed a KRW 350.1bn construction contract with affiliate IPARK I&Cons for a Jinju apartment project.
Camus Engineering & Construction: Kamu E&C won a KRW 29.5bn contract for the Gangbuk–Amsa water transmission connection works from the Public Procurement Service.
Seohee Construction: Seohee Construction won a KRW 134.98bn contract for new apartment construction for the Anyang Surisan Regional Housing Association.
Daewon: Daewon's board approved the small-scale absorption merger of wholly owned subsidiary Daewon Mobang, replacing a shareholder meeting, effective 1 January 2027.
Ilsung Construction: Ilsung Construction won a KRW 46.4bn share of a Cambodian rural connectivity project from Cambodia's Ministry of Rural Development.
KCC Engineering & Construction: KCC Engineering & Construction signed a KRW 148.5bn contract for the Gimpo Gamjeong logistics center construction project.
Samho Development: Samho Development won a KRW 33.99bn construction order from Ssangyong Engineering & Construction for Nambu Inland Railway Section 8-2 roadbed works.
KolonGlobalCorporation: KolonGlobalCorporation won a KRW 77.7bn order to build Simmtech's Cheongju 2 plant, equal to 2.89% of recent revenue.

Namkwang Engineering & Construction: Namkwang Engineering & Construction won a KRW 31.66bn construction contract from Korea Water Resources Corporation for a Godeok industrial complex water supply project.
Bumyang Construction: Bumyang Construction's sub-KRW 500 million quarterly revenue will not trigger a listing eligibility review because delisting was already decided on 21 September 2026.
Dongbu: Dongbu won a KRW 190.2bn contract for apartment construction in Sangdong, Wonmi-gu, Bucheon, equal to 10.81% of recent revenue.
Sambu Construction: Sambu Construction discloses improvement plan after being granted an improvement period until 13 November 2027 in its listing eligibility review.
Woojin I&S: Korea Exchange warns Woojin INS common shares may be designated administrative issue after market cap stayed below KRW 30bn for 25 trading days.
DL E&C: DL E&C won a KRW 406.2bn contract for the Shinseong Shinan Ssangyong Jinheung Apartment remodeling project in Suwon, signed 2026-11-12.
Aptn: Aptn's board decided on a 90.00% free capital reduction via a 10-to-1 reverse split of common shares to offset accumulated deficit.
KUMHO Engineering & Construction: Kumho Engineering & Construction won a KRW 372.0bn order to build Songdo Severance Hospital from Yonsei University Health System.
DongwonDevelopment: Dongwon Development signed a KRW 35.07bn contract with Busan Metropolitan City Construction Headquarters for the BEXCO Exhibition Hall 3 project.
Dongbu: Dongbu Corporation signed a KRW 164.0bn contract for the Livestock Resources Development Division relocation project, 9.32% of revenue.
KUMHO Engineering & Construction: Kumho Engineering & Construction won a KRW 327.9bn order to relocate the Animal Genetic Resources Division, equal to 16.25% of revenue.
HJ Shipbuilding & Construction: HJ Heavy Industries won a KRW 95.5bn order for the BEXCO Exhibition Hall 3 construction project, 4.78% of recent revenue.
Kye-ryong Construction Industrial: Gyeryong Construction Industrial won a KRW 83.8bn order for the BEXCO Third Exhibition Hall construction project in Busan.
KEPCO Plant Service & Engineering: KEPCO KPS Q3 2026 consolidated operating profit was KRW 11.7bn, down 75.43% year on year on revenue of KRW 330.5bn.
Kye-ryong Construction Industrial: Kyeryong Construction Industrial won a KRW 97.6bn order for the Southwest Comprehensive Sports Town sports facility construction in Daejeon.
HL D&I Halla: HL D&I reported Q3 2026 consolidated operating profit of KRW 30.1bn on revenue of KRW 471.7bn, up 18.1% year on year.
Ilsung Construction: Ilsung Construction disclosed termination of a KRW 47.9bn construction contract after the counterparty gave notice of cancellation on 2026-08-12.
